_note: The two abilities you pick on landing (battle royale) or at the first countdown (1v1v1, bots). Names are ours. JOLT's distance and cooldown are the owner's numbers; its duration and exit speed are ours. TRIAGE's scale is the owner's (twice as fast = every heal item's use time halved).

jolt.name: JOLT
jolt.blurb: dash 10 m the way you are moving, every 3 s

triage.name: TRIAGE
triage.blurb: every heal works twice as fast

bots._note: ours: a JOLT bot jolts sideways when it has been hit in the last this many seconds; every bot heals when it has had no target for healAfter seconds
